description: Migrate frontend from Express server to Firebase Firestore + Next.js API routes + Pinata, eliminating the server dependency entirely

userStories.title: Audit all server calls in frontend
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a complete inventory of every place the frontend calls the Express server so that nothing is missed during migration.
acceptanceCriteria: List every file in frontend/ that references SERVER_API or nodeEnv.SERVER_API
List every Next.js API route in pages/api/_v2/ that calls the Express server internally
Categorize each call by domain (destinations, assets)
Document the request/response shape for each endpoint
Create a migration checklist saved to tasks/migration-checklist.md
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Set up Firestore destinations collection and helpers
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Firestore destinations collection with helper functions so that destination data can be stored and queried from Firebase.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a destinations Firestore collection schema doc matching the current MongoDB Destination model, including a userId field to associate destinations with their owner
Create Firestore helper module (e.g. frontend/utils/firestore/destinations.ts) with typed read/write functions using the existing firebaseAdmin.js db export
Ensure index on userId for user-specific queries like get my spaces
Create Firestore security rules for the destinations collection
Verify read/write operations work from Next.js API routes using the existing firebaseAdmin.js setup
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created frontend/utils/firestore/destinations.ts (typed CRUD helpers), tasks/destinations-firestore-schema.md (schema doc), firestore.indexes.json (composite indexes for userId, tag, status, isClaimActive+endTime), firestore.rules (security rules). Typecheck passes.

Response shape matches the current format: { success: true, data: { params, paths, ...rest } }

userStories.notes: getDestinationBySlug API route now queries Firestore via helper. saveToDb.ts getDestination() and getDestinationBySlug() both use DestinationService RPC client instead of SERVER_API. Response shape preserved. Typecheck passes.
